title: Topic Is Not Agenda: A Citation-Community Audit of Text Embeddings
why_relevant: Audits embedding-based retrieval failures at fine granularity, exposing a concrete failure mode of scientific RAG where top neighbors are off-agenda, which relates to noisy/imprecise retrieval.
why_not_or_caveat: Focuses on embedding semantics vs citation communities rather than robustness, conflict, adversarial, or calibration aspects central to the survey.
